questions.q: Tell me about a full-stack MERN project you built. What did the app do, and which parts of the front end, back end and database did you build?
questions.looks_for: A real app with clear purpose, their own work across React, Node/Express and MongoDB, key design decisions, and how it was deployed or used.

questions.q: Describe a time an API you built had a problem in production or testing. How did you find and fix it?
questions.looks_for: Uses logs, error messages, reproducing the request, checking database queries. Explains root cause, fix, and what was added to prevent repeats such as validation or tests.

questions.q: How would you design the MongoDB data for an app where users place orders containing many products? What would you embed and what would you reference?
questions.looks_for: Weighs embedding versus referencing: e.g. store a snapshot of product name and price inside the order, reference the user and product IDs. Considers query patterns, document growth and indexes.

questions.q: How would you add secure login to a MERN app, and what mistakes would you avoid?
questions.looks_for: Hashes passwords (bcrypt or similar), uses tokens or sessions properly, HTTPS, short-lived tokens, secure cookie settings, server-side checks on every protected route. Avoids storing secrets in front-end code.

questions.q: A list page in your app loads thousands of records and is slow. What would you change on the back end and front end?
questions.looks_for: Server-side pagination or infinite scroll, database indexes, returning only needed fields, caching where suitable, and on the front end avoiding unnecessary re-renders or virtualising long lists.

questions.q: A teammate pushes a fix on Friday evening that breaks checkout on the live site. What do you do?
questions.looks_for: Puts customers first: confirms the issue, rolls back or reverts quickly, informs the team, checks orders affected, then looks at the root cause and adds tests or review steps. No blame.

questions.q: Why do you want to work as a full-stack developer, and what do you want to grow into? Please state clearly your notice period or joining date, and your expected salary in ₹ per month or per year?
questions.looks_for: Gives a genuine reason tied to the work, a sensible growth direction, a clear notice period or joining date, and a clear salary figure or range in ₹. Honest about buyout or negotiable notice if relevant.
